description: Frame-time breakdown for a game: global percentiles, per-level p50/p95/p99 with draw calls / triangles / geometry counts / game-context gauges, hitch causes (script, shader compile, PSO compile in Unreal, GC, asset or map load), what is on screen during hitches, which events precede hitches, per GPU tier / browser / platform / version, per screen (by_display: each refresh rate's sessions, its budget_ms and share of play, so 120 Hz and 60 Hz phones read apart), per zone for an open-world game or hub that sets them (by_zone: each zone's frame time and hitches_per_min, and its time: seconds and share_pct of play time, sessions that went there and median_s, their median time in it; zone keeps one), memory growth per level load and the slowest recent hitches with script attribution. Every frame is judged against its own screen's budget: pct_over_budget is the share of frames slower than 1.15x their own window's budget_ms (under 5% means the p95 is on time on players' own screens; a 60 Hz phone's 16.7 ms frames are on time next to 120 Hz ones), so read it, not p95 against frame_budget_ms (the median screen's). With by_prop, frame time, hitches and crash-free sessions per value of a session property (a graphics preset, a class). A multiplayer game also gets `network` (ping, loss and disconnects; glitchless_network has more).

by_prop.description: A session property (glitchless_events lists them), e.g. "preset": frame time, hitches and crash-free sessions per value, over 31 days or less

env.description: Only include sessions from this environment, e.g. "prod" (what the game passes to init; builds a developer runs usually send "dev")

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. With a key for one game (gl_sk_…), a call that names another game is refused: sign in to the workspace to reach every game.

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24), as far back as the workspace keeps data on Glitchless Cloud (the answer says when it starts later than asked). Past 744 (31 days) answers are by day.

level.description: Focus on one level id, e.g. "level-2"

props.description: Only sessions with these session properties (what the game set with setProperties): { rank: "diamond" }, or a list of values for any of them, { rank: ["diamond", "master"] }; "(none)" keeps the sessions without one. glitchless_events lists the properties and their values. Read from the sessions, so over 31 days or less

service.description: Game service name (defaults to the most recently active game)

session_type.description: "user": players only; "tester": people on TestFlight and other test builds only; "synthetic": bots, playtests and store test devices only; "all" or unset: every session. Findings (glitchless_triage, and the overview's) read the production sessions of players unless env or session_type is given

steam_branch.description: Only include sessions that ran this Steam branch ("public", or a beta's name); games that use Steamworks send it

version.description: Only include sessions from this game version

zone.description: Focus on one zone, as the game names it with setZone ("hall"): its by_zone row and its recent hitches

name: glitchless_performance
title: Performance
